description: This file defines the SpyHashStateImpl class, a testing utility implementing the HashState API for accumulating input bytes and comparing hash representations, primarily used for testing AbslHashValue overloads within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: SpyHashStateImpl
classes.description: A template class implementing HashState that accumulates input bytes for testing hash functions and overloads.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines multiple hash state objects and values into a new hash state.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two hash state objects based on their internal representations.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two hash state objects.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two hash states for equality or suffix relationships.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the hash representation as a formatted hex and ASCII dump.

methods.name: combine_contiguous
methods.description: Adds raw bytes to the hash state from a contiguous memory block.

methods.name: RunCombineUnordered
methods.description: Combines unordered elements into the hash state.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns an error message if the hash state is invalid or moved-from.
